headline: 罗摩衍那领跑电影，再婚皇后点燃新剧

headlineEn: Ramayana leads films; Remarried Empress ignites new dramas
summaryEn: This week's film highlights include Ramayana: The Legend of Prince Rama and Godzilla-0.0; on TV, The Remarried Empress and Youth Commune premiere, while The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power and Reacher are hot.
